title: CRC Machzor (2008)
source: shireishabbat research/current-siddurim/Machzor-2008.pdf (221-page scan; printed folios 1-215, PDF offset -6). Entries from the transcription-mz UNITS captures, spot-verified against the scan: Rosh Hashanah morning (38-92) plus Adon Olam (129). title: Shirei Shabbat — Shabbat Morning
source: shireishabbat dist-app/shabbat-shacharit-feed.json @8cc8d9a+dirty (ALPHA DRAFT, not a printed volume; folios never published - Ruling 8, 2026-09-15). pages = last FOLIO number, measured as physical pages minus this book's constant folio offset of 7: the feed records printing.pages 151 and its pageIndex runs folios 2..143, so 151-7 = 144. RE-RECORDED from 146 (2026-09-15, R2-b). 146 was correct and measured, for a different build: dist/ @8ab7be6 was 153 physical pages at the same offset. The number is build-dependent precisely because this book has never been printed - there is no press commit to pin it to, which is why R2-b dropped the pin. Offset 7 is the stable quantity; it is the front matter, and it did not change between the two builds (maariv holds 6 and shirei-tshuvah, a printed volume, holds 4 across both). Re-record whenever dist-app is rebuilt, from printing.pages minus 7.
